chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, and Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about the one who performed Tawaf of the House as an obligatory Tawaf, but did not know whether he had performed six circuits or seven. He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should face [the Kaaba] again.' I said: 'So he lost that one.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is nothing upon him.'

key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ: There is nothing upon him (no penalty)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one is unsure whether they completed six or seven circuits of Tawaf?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar asks Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about a pilgrim uncertain whether they completed six or seven circuits during the obligatory Tawaf. The Imam clarifies that the pilgrim should perform one additional circuit to be safe, and if they do, they are not considered to have 'lost' the first one; rather, the extra circuit is accepted, and there is no penalty or requirement to repeat the entire ritual.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, and Safwan Bin Yahya, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,

‘I asked himasws about the one who performs Tawaaf by the House (Kaaba) with an Obligatory Tawaaf, but he does not know whether he did six circuits or seven. Heasws said: ‘He should not it again’. I said, ‘So he lost that one’. Heasws said: ‘There is nothing upon him’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from all from ibn abu ‘Umayr and from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who performs obligatory Tawaf and does not know if he has done six or seven Tawaf (walking around the House). He (the Imam) said, ‘He must do it again.’”
